text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000101 bills 99215 far above expectation even after risk adjustment, but the 99215s cluster on multi-morbid patients and every documented 99215 was supported, so the pattern is not clearly upcoding.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"Most of this provider's 99215s fall on patients with four or more chronic conditions (for example C0050994, C0051042, C0051115), which fits a sicker panel, and only a few low-complexity 99215s appear (C0050940, C0050955). However, the 99215 share within the 4-condition and 5+ strata is still several times the all-provider share for the same strata, so complexity alone does not explain the excess the risk-adjusted score captures. The records review favors legitimacy: all documented 99215s (e.g., C0050950, C0051048) showed high MDM, and there is no sign of inflated data-reviewed claims without lab lines. That review covers only 7 of 83 99215 claims, so it is too thin to clear the pattern, and two of the supported charts record no minutes. A reviewer should first request a larger sample of 99215 charts, prioritizing the low-complexity claims listed here, and check whether the high-MDM notes show templated or cloned language across patients."}
